description: This file implements the Hibernate-based data access object (DAO) for managing 'Condition' entities in the OpenMRS health records system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and delete medical condition records associated with patients and encounters.

classes.name: HibernateConditionDAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of the ConditionDAO interface handling CRUD operations for Condition objects.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its integer ID.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its UUID.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches a list of Conditions associated with a specific Encounter.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Fetches all active Conditions related to a Patient, filtered by clinical statuses indicating activity.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Retrieves all Conditions for a Patient that are not voided.

methods.name: deleteCondition
methods.description: Removes a Condition from the database.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Saves or updates a Condition entity in the database.
